boundary: Publisher-verified measured-study evidence added after wave-6 acquisition review. These entries support mechanism review but do not increment canonical raw-data/sample counts.

entries.title: General Industrial Process Optimization Method to Leverage Machine Learning Applied to Injection Moulding
entries.physicalOutcome: Per-cycle molded-part quality scores are linked to measured process and cooling state.
entries.limitation: Publisher states data sharing is not applicable; the study is evidence, not an open raw-data family.

entries.title: Optimization of mold thermal control for minimum energy consumption in injection molding of polypropylene parts
experimentalEvidence: 86 monitored moulds and relative injection machines
entries.physicalOutcome: A representative process could reduce coolant flow by 66% without compromising molded-part quality under the tested conditions.
entries.limitation: Plant, product, mould, hot-runner and cooling-network configuration are application-specific; the 66% result is not a universal setting.

entries.title: Algorithm for assessing the level of cooling channel contamination in injection mold
entries.physicalOutcome: Experimental flow/pressure measurements support an objective estimate of cooling-channel contamination condition.
entries.dataAvailability: Available from corresponding author on reasonable request.
entries.limitation: Condition inference depends on the tested channel geometry, medium, pressure range and contamination state.

entries.title: Deep-learning-based fault detection and recipe optimization for a plastic injection molding process under the class-imbalance problem
entries.physicalOutcome: Fault labels identify anomalous production observations; selected signals show labelled outlier behavior.
entries.limitation: The public article does not establish an openly reusable raw dataset or a rich taxonomy of physical failure causes.

entries.title: Data-driven quality prediction in injection molding: An autoencoder and machine learning approach
entries.physicalOutcome: Physical dimensional and mass outcomes were predicted from measured cavity-pressure information.
entries.dataAvailability: Data can be provided on request.
entries.limitation: Small controlled experimental family; model prediction quality does not create universal pressure-quality thresholds.

entries.title: Real-Time Optimal Parameter Recommendation for Injection Molding Machines Using AI with Limited Dataset
experimentalEvidence: separate control and measured parameter classes
entries.physicalOutcome: Industrial process data were used for parameter recommendation and productivity optimization; the dataset preserves the distinction between operator controls and measured feedback.
entries.dataAvailability: Available from authors upon request and only with permission from KHW.
entries.limitation: Underlying company data are restricted; article CC BY does not license the production dataset.

stillMissing: verified maintenance intervention and post-cleaning recovery
